releaseNotes:
# Changelog 0.0.261

## Changes (initial history)

- fix(nes): restore the full pulse 1 state on SFX end (no duty/volume residue) (#235) (`d5a520a`)
- fix(gb): play SFX on channel 1 with BGM priority (no music corruption) (#234) (`57e6317`)
- NES: portable SFX action audio that plays cleanly over the BGM (#233) (`f6b295b`)
- Projectiles: fix muzzle-flash glitch and add focused 2-shot cap samples (#232) (`201a323`)
- Fix projectile follow-up issues (#231) (`a3bbe7c`)
- feat(sdk): honor projectile Request direction (left/right) (#222) (#230) (`bf9279e`)
- feat(sdk): portable projectile framework MVP (#220) (#228) (`cb1117b`)
- runner: make the main loop readable via SimulatePlayer extraction (#221) (`529ab8c`)
- feat: add NES DMC audio playback (#219) (`3042a8f`)
- fix(codegen): preserve carry in 16-bit +=/-= with an i8 operand (nes/gb) (#218) (`d17a2f2`)
- Remove loop keyword from language (#216) (`0e46c37`)
- Resolve issues 210-214 (`26fb59c`)
- chore: ignore local CodeGraph index (`1543c77`)
- docs: validate source-only SDK library boundary (#209) (`74337fb`)
- SDKAGN-5: rename SdkDotCallSyntax to generic QualifiedCallSyntax (#208) (`3389e5c`)
- SDKAGN: make the compiler fully SDK-agnostic (retire SdkModuleRegistry) (#207) (`2717b86`)
- SDKLIB-6: decouple complex SDK facades (#199) (`b61f1bf`)
- SDKLIB-5: move resource facades to package contracts (#198) (`83fc04c`)
- SDKLIB-4: retire simple runtime facade registry mappings (#197) (`19ae611`)
- SDKLIB-3: consolidate target intrinsic descriptors (#196) (`148defd`)
- SDKLIB-2: materialize Portable2D source package (#195) (`a136902`)
- SDKLIB-7: guard against SDK API name leaks (#194) (`91fb89d`)
- SDKLIB-1: load libraries from project manifests (#193) (`7607fda`)
- feat: add physical namespace usings (#182) (`c6bfc88`)
- feat: add qualified physical namespace names (#181) (`da5c4b9`)
- feat(sdk): add manifests and physical namespaces (#180) (`7578c99`)
- feat(sdk): make SDK imports registry-driven (#179) (`7bc866d`)
- feat(sdk): add explicit Portable2D import (#178) (`b911f15`)
- docs(AGENTS): make PR + merge the default way to land changes into master (#177) (`93877c8`)
- lang: signed relational comparison for i8, removing the runner's signed-velocity-wrap hack (#176) (`67b0ef6`)
- camera: make Camera.SetPosition walk to the requested position, removing the runner double-call (`4ff92f7`)
- Resolve RetroSharp issues 171-174 (#175) (`43737c2`)
- runner: drop redundant trailing 'return;' from void functions (`779cbea`)
- runner: split grab-bag HorizontalMotion enum into Direction + MotionSpeed (`3da615e`)
- docs: fix CONTRIBUTING branch model to match reality (master, GitHubFlow) (`dd85a07`)
- PascalCase all function names: Main entry point + user free functions (`1481f62`)
- #157: remove lowercase facade aliases — PascalCase is the only dot-call spelling (`5fb2124`)
- #157: emit PascalCase facades from the actor-framework lowerer (`5a99355`)
- #157: make PascalCase static facades canonical across samples and docs (`2b72e97`)
- #105: split WorldMap2D into portable flags + target WorldTileGrid (`dff15ed`)
- SAL-8.9: migrate gb/nes camera.ScreenAabb collision to target intrinsics (`4607ec9`)
- SAL-8.8: migrate gb/nes audio.Init to audio_init target intrinsic (`3261e96`)
- docs: recommend branch/worktree workflow in AGENTS.md (`246ed78`)
- SAL-8.7: migrate gb/nes music.Play/Stop to audio target intrinsics (`6315a93`)
- SAL-8.6: migrate nes camera collision intrinsics (`15dfd35`)
- SAL-8.6: validate compile-time operand integration (`cb8e99d`)
- SAL-8.5: migrate game boy camera collision intrinsics (`dc6ba97`)
- SAL-8.4: migrate nes sprite draw intrinsic (`c50638f`)
- SAL-8.3: migrate game boy sprite draw intrinsic (`6318e52`)
- SAL-8.2: add compile-time operand descriptors (`5712b1c`)
